label: Codex

state.note: written by the materializer from harness/codex/models.json with every multi_agent_version set to null, so the seat cannot start Codex-native subagents and Paseo stays the only control plane
state.nullFieldsNote: fields the materializer sets to null in every model-catalog entry, so the seat cannot start this harness's native subagents and Paseo stays the only control plane

guards.dirNote: relative to harness/; the shell guards are protocol-generic and shared, so every hook-based harness points at common/guards
guards.shellToolNote: unset: nobody has confirmed what this harness calls its shell tool in a hook payload, so the merge gate does not hold here. Settle it in NOTES.md before sending a gated role to this harness.

deny.note: Paseo applies disallowedTools only to its claude and omp providers, so a Codex seat has no deny list. subagents is held by the nulled multi_agent_version in the room's model catalog; git-push, forge-cli and agent-cli by lead-guard.sh reading each shell command. file-edit is left out of enforcedByGuard on purpose: sandbox_mode = read-only in a role overlay does hold it, but that is per role (the Peer's overlay is workspace-write), so the report stays conservative and tells you to check the overlay. The rest are unenforced until its hooks cover them.

skillLoad.phraseNote: a noun phrase, because guards say "Load it with <phrase>"

probe.note: resolve the open questions in NOTES.md, then set verified to the Codex version you confirmed them on

provider.envNote: SEATWORKS_CODEX_ENV_KEY names the variable Codex reads the API key from; the key itself is never written here or anywhere else in the kit. Export it for the Paseo daemon.
provider.defaultModelNote: the model a role on this harness gets when seats.json names none and --model is not passed. Spelled the way this harness spells a model: Pi wants provider/id, Codex wants the bare slug with model_provider set separately.
provider.baseCredentialNote: null: this harness authenticates through the login file in links, not through a token on its Paseo base provider.
provider.envPrefixNote: the prefix setup-seats.fish passes through to this harness's materializer, so no script names the harness.
provider.commandNote: every harness launches through the shared room, which resolves the project from the agent's working directory, points configDirEnv at that project's seat directory, and execs the binary in provider.env.SEATWORKS_AGENT_BIN with every argument untouched

linksNote: skills is not linked here: skillsDir owns the seat's own skills directory, which is the point of a per-seat room. An optional link whose target is missing is skipped.
promptCommentsNote: informational. Every .md in this kit is comment-free so it loads unchanged on every harness; setup refuses `<!--` whatever this says. A safety review reads it to know whether a leaked note would reach the seat.
